title: Sangoma Switchvox: attackers can read or change its database
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 107 days old, so current versions are being attacked. Ready-made attack tools are public. The severity score is critical (9.3).

category.label: Business software
category.why: It runs day-to-day business work such as finance, printing, phones or manufacturing.
category.doThis: Ask the vendor or the team that owns it whether the fix is in.

summary: Sangoma Switchvox contains a SQL injection vulnerability which allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements against the backend PostgreSQL database using a single crafted request, including database operations and remote code execution.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 5, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
